query:
SELECT o.id as org_id, o.name as org_name, u.id as user_id, u.email, u.name as user_name, u.isPrimaryAdmin, u.createdAt
FROM organizations o 
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.organizationId = o.id 
WHERE u.isPrimaryAdmin = 1
ORDER BY o.id;
